rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when commuting means regularly going to one’s workplace.

example.english: I commute to work by bus every day.
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 daap3 baa1 si2 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this instead of 返工 when the regular destination is school.

example.english: They commute to school together every morning.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ziu1 ziu1 jat1 cai4 faan1 hok6

rows.note: Use this in legal contexts when a criminal sentence is reduced.

example.english: The court decided to commute his sentence in the end.
example.traditional: 法庭最後決定幫佢減刑。
example.jyutping: faat3 ting4 zeoi3 hau6 kyut3 ding6 bong1 keoi5 gaam2 jing4

rows.note: Use this when a payment permanently settles or buys out an ongoing obligation.

example.english: This payment can commute the remaining instalments, so we will not have to pay again.
example.traditional: 呢筆錢可以買斷餘下供款，之後唔使再畀。
example.jyutping: ni1 bat1 cin2 ho2 ji5 maai5 tyun5 jyu4 haa6 gung1 fun2 zi1 hau6 m4 sai2 zoi3 bei2
